events.text: Before building the geometric equivalences, I’m isolating one reusable algebra lemma the codebase currently lacks: scalar extension of a submodule with projective quotient is canonically equivalent to its base-changed submodule. This removes duplicated split-injectivity proofs on both universal windows and keeps the geometric square readable.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivSchemeProjectiveBaseChange.lean
+/-

+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+-/
+
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivCarveKit
+
+/-!
+# Base change of a submodule with projective quotient
+
+The inclusion of a submodule with projective quotient is split.  Consequently its
+scalar extension is injective over an arbitrary algebra, without a flatness
+hypothesis on that algebra.  This packages the resulting identification with
+`Submodule.baseChange`.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian
+
+variable {R S M : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
+variable [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
+
+/-- Scalar extension of a submodule with projective quotient, identified with the
+submodule generated by its image after base change. -/
+noncomputable def projectiveQuotientBaseChangeEquiv (N : Submodule R M)
+    [Module.Projective R (M ⧸ N)] :
+    S ⊗[R] N ≃ₗ[S] N.baseChange S := by
+  have hsplit : quotRetract N ∘ₗ N.subtype = LinearMap.id :=
+    LinearMap.ext fun x => quotRetract_apply_of_mem N x.2
+  have hinj : Function.Injective (LinearMap.baseChange S N.subtype) := by
+    have hleft : LinearMap.baseChange S (quotRetract N) ∘ₗ
+        LinearMap.baseChange S N.subtype = LinearMap.id := by
+      rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_comp, hsplit, LinearMap.baseChange_id]
+    exact Function.LeftInverse.injective
+      (g := LinearMap.baseChange S (quotRetract N))
+      fun x => by rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hleft, LinearMap.id_apply]
+  refine LinearEquiv.ofBijective (N.toBaseChange S) ⟨?_, N.toBaseChange_surjective S⟩
+  intro x y hxy
+  apply hinj
+  exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
+
+@[simp]
+theorem projectiveQuotientBaseChangeEquiv_apply (N : Submodule R M)
+    [Module.Projective R (M ⧸ N)] (x : S ⊗[R] N) :
+    projectiveQuotientBaseChangeEquiv (S := S) N x = N.toBaseChange S x :=
+  rfl
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
